description: IAM User Has a Potential PassRole Path to a Privileged Service Role
rationale: A user and its verified groups collectively have identity-policy Allow for iam:PassRole and service-resource creation into a role with administrator-like policy and compatible service trust. This is not effective AWS authorization or a demonstrated exploit.
remediation: Scope PassRole resources and iam:PassedToService, limit workload creation and verify policy boundaries, organization controls and access path.
